probability_space.outer: one fixed EBCH constituent repeated in every outer row
probability_space.routing: independent uniform row-coordinate and region permutations
probability_space.inner: independent RandomStepConv-M30 matrices sampled once and shared by every message

proof_accounting.occupations_2_through_99: exact uniform-subset regions after aligned parity-input deletion
proof_accounting.occupations_100_through_16384: dispersed parity pivots and two positive coefficient bounds
proof_accounting.pivot_polynomial: bounded by (Q+1) times its largest exactly located term
proof_accounting.arithmetic: Arb transcendental enclosures plus one-ULP outward positive binary64 matrix recurrences

limitations: The theorem concerns RandomStepConv, not RM2Sub.
The random inner is a proof comparator; no efficient representation or implementation is claimed.
The fixed BCH spectrum is imported from scripts/EBCH128_64.wd and must be hash-bound in the final manifest.
